title: adenostylis formosana
intro: Adenostylis formosana, commonly known as Formosan silver grass, is a type of flowering plant in the family Apiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include acting as a diuretic, expectorant, and antispasmodic, making it useful in treating conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Adenostylis formosana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and coumarins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
